$comment: Canonical invariant registry for wavefunction-field v0.1. Every INV-* id MUST be referenced by at least one test (a test function whose docstring or name contains the id), enforced by scripts/check_traceability.py in CI. G-* ids are enforced by the named CI check. Statements are the contract; test_hint is guidance, not a limit.

global.statement: Branch + PR only. Never push to main, merge, tag, publish to PyPI or any MCP registry, deploy, or change repository visibility.
No secrets in the repo. gitleaks passes; private keys and tokens come only from env or files outside the repo.
No network access in tests or CI beyond package installation. The core package performs no I/O.
global.enforced_by: ci: pytest with socket blocked (pytest-socket-equivalent fixture in conftest); scripts/check_core_purity.py

global.statement: Dependencies are limited to the allowlist in AGENTS.md. Any addition requires a CODEX_NOTES.md entry and stops the WP.

Claims match evidence. No 'quantum', 'proven', 'verified alignment', 'energy savings', 'joules' or similar claims in code, docs or tool descriptions unless an artifact in the repo measures it; metaphor terms are labelled as metaphors.
global.enforced_by: ci: scripts/check_claims.py (denylist grep with allowlisted terminology note)

global.statement: Determinism: identical (event log, now_ms, params, view) gives byte-identical canonical outputs. No wall clock or RNG in core.
Traceability: every INV-* id has at least one test; no test references an unknown id.
Python ≥ 3.11; ruff clean; mypy --strict clean on src/wavefunction_field/core and src/wavefunction_field/identity; SPDX Apache-2.0 header on every source file; DCO sign-off; conventional commits.
Never weaken, skip or delete a test to make it pass. Spec contradictions or blocked invariants go in CODEX_NOTES.md in a draft PR with options.

invariants.statement: A write is accepted only if actor_id == agent_id(pubkey) per the derivation rule; the test vector agent_id is reproduced exactly.

A write is accepted only if the Ed25519 signature verifies over canonical(envelope); mutating any single byte of the canonical envelope or signature causes rejection; the test vector signature verifies.

(actor_id, nonce) is accepted at most once, including across process restart with the SQLite store; a replay is rejected unless it carries a known idempotency key with an identical body, in which case the original result is returned and nothing is appended (decision 0002).
Writes with |signed_at − now| > skew_s are rejected with ValidationError; boundary values ±skew_s are accepted.
canonical() reproduces the test vector bytes; equals viridis-agent-market-v1 _stable() for any float-free JSON value; signed bodies containing floats, NaN or Infinity are rejected.
invariants.test_hint: hypothesis-generated JSON compared to json.dumps(sort_keys, separators, ensure_ascii=True)

invariants.statement: Same (actor, idempotency_key, body) returns the original result and appends no event, whether the nonce is new or replayed; same key with a different body returns ContextError idempotency_conflict; idempotent returns do not consume quota (decision 0002).
No tool output, log record, event, exception message or HTTP response contains private key bytes or their base64/hex encodings; the agent key file is created with mode 0600.
invariants.test_hint: capture all outputs during an end-to-end run and scan for key encodings

invariants.statement: Absent new events, S_trusted and the raw pre-cap untrusted sum U each satisfy X(t2) = X(t1)·2^(−(t2−t1)/h_A) within 1e-12 relative error; caps (untrusted_signal_cap, A_max) apply only afterwards; decay test vectors reproduce (decision 0002).
0 ≤ A(i,t) ≤ A_max and 0 ≤ A_eff(i,t) ≤ A_max for every intent, time and view.

Lazy evaporation equivalence (decision 0002): for any op sequence and query time, the canonical projection, all intent/agent/result fields (incl. evaporated_at_ms = closed-form t_evap) and the outputs of get_intent, list_intents, get_agent, sense, route and metrics are identical whether or not sweep() ran. Excluded: the audit stream (/v1/events, seq, event counts) and chain metadata (head hash, /healthz). Projection and metrics contain no event counts, seq or hashes.
invariants.test_hint: two stores fed the same ops, one swept; compare read models, not the event stream

invariants.statement: For ACTIVE agents with declared tag τ (or τ='*'): w_min ≤ W_V(τ,a,t) ≤ w_max; for undeclared tags: 0 ≤ W ≤ w_max.

W moves away from its floor only through qualifying verifications (verifier ∈ V.verifiers, emitter ∈ V.emitters, doer ∉ {emitter, verifier}); any event stream with no qualifying verification leaves every W at floor.
H = −Σ p log2 p with p from integer weights; 0 ≤ H ≤ log2(n); H = 0 iff n = 1; test vector H reproduces within 1e-12.
The core package is pure: no imports of time, datetime.now, random, os, socket, sqlite3, httpx or asyncio; identical inputs give identical outputs.
Signals from agents outside V.emitters ∪ V.verifiers contribute at most untrusted_signal_cap to A(i,t), for any number of such agents.
For a non-empty candidate set: p ≥ 0, |Σp − 1| < 1e-9, ψ = sqrt(p), |Σψ² − 1| < 1e-9 (fleet contract I-6); the full distribution over all candidates is returned.

For an agent in the candidate set, holding everything else fixed, increasing W(τ,a) for a tag of the intent (an effective increase, not absorbed by the w_max clamp) strictly increases p(a) unless p(a) = 1 (decision 0002).
If at least k_explore floor-tier candidates exist outside the top-k, the output contains exactly k_explore entries marked explore=true, disjoint from the top-k, ordered by η desc then agent_id asc.
route and sense outputs are totally ordered with deterministic tie-breaks (agent_id / intent_id ascending); permuting input order never changes output.

Resonance links follow PROTOCOL §7.1 (decision 0002): symmetric (j ∈ links(i) ⇔ i ∈ links(j)), never self-links (fleet contract I-7), deg ≤ max_links_per_intent for every intent at all times, and deterministic bounded selection — candidates OPEN with sim_ii ≥ θ_res, visited by sim desc then intent_id asc, linked iff both endpoints are below the cap.
invariants.test_hint: 18+ identical intents (the K18 counterexample) → every degree ≤ 16, symmetric, selection matches a reference ordering; shuffle emit timing within ties

invariants.statement: Resonance boost counts at most one linked intent per distinct emitter (excluding the intent's own emitter) and A_eff ≤ A_max.

REVOKED agents and the field key never appear in route output; the emitter is never a candidate for its own intent; terminal intents never appear in sense output; the field key cannot emit, deposit or submit results (decision 0002).
Only the transitions in PROTOCOL §4 occur; COLLAPSED, WITHDRAWN and EVAPORATED are absorbing.
An intent collapses at most once; the first permitted PASS (verifier allowed for the acceptance kind, independent of trust views) wins; later submit_result or verify on it returns ContextError.
A transition of intent i never changes the state of any other intent, including resonant, parent and child intents.

Only the emitter can withdraw or reweight; only listed designated verifiers other than the doer can verify designated intents; machine verifiers run only for their acceptance kind; 'lean' is rejected.
At most one active lease per (agent, intent); lease_s ≤ lease.max_s; expired or released leases stop affecting sense; a non-leaseholder's result is still accepted.
A sub-intent's parent exists and is OPEN at emit time, and depth ≤ intent.max_depth.
The event log is append-only: the store API has no update/delete, and SQLite triggers abort UPDATE and DELETE on events.

hash = sha256(prev_hash_hex + canonical(event minus hash)); genesis prev_hash is 64 zeros; verify_chain() returns false after any single-field mutation of any event (applied via a raw connection that drops triggers).
Rebuilding the projection from the log gives canonical bytes identical to the live projection after any random op sequence, for Memory and SQLite stores alike.
SQLite store runs WAL with synchronous=FULL, and an append returns only after commit; a write acknowledged before a simulated crash (close without checkpoint, reopen) is present after reopen.

Every string authored by an agent other than the caller appears in HTTP/MCP outputs only inside {untrusted:{author,text}}; no tool description contains agent-authored text; every tool description includes the data-not-instructions sentence.
invariants.test_hint: walk all outputs for bare foreign strings

invariants.statement: Over-length fields are rejected (never truncated); C0/C1 controls except \n \t and bidi controls U+202A–U+202E, U+2066–U+2069 never appear in stored text.
Only https URLs are accepted; loopback, private, link-local, .local and private-range IP-literal hosts are rejected; the field never fetches any URL (no HTTP client is invoked during writes).

The agent-side MCP server refuses claim and submit_result on intents whose side_effects ⊄ allow_side_effects (default empty), returning PermissionError with human_approval_required=true, and sends nothing to the field.
Per-actor quotas (writes_per_minute, open_intents_per_emitter, results_per_intent_per_doer) are enforced with BudgetError and no event appended.
The manifest and every write tool description state that all content is public and must not include secrets or personal data; no schema has a private/visibility field.
invariants.test_hint: string assertions on manifest and tool list

invariants.statement: No input to POST /v1/write, /v1/sense, /v1/route or any MCP tool produces an unhandled exception or HTTP 5xx; malformed input returns a 4xx with a taxonomy error envelope and appends no event.
invariants.test_hint: hypothesis fuzz of JSON bodies via Starlette TestClient

invariants.statement: The simulator drives the production FieldService through signed envelopes; it never imports routing/dynamics functions directly to compute outcomes, and arms differ only by params override and view.
invariants.test_hint: AST import scan of sim package

invariants.statement: Same scenario, seed and code produce byte-identical CSV, JSON and Markdown outputs.
invariants.test_hint: run twice small config, compare hashes

invariants.statement: Pass thresholds are read only from spec/sim_preregistration.json; the report embeds its sha256 and shows PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE as measured; CI fails if the file hash differs from spec/PREREG_LOCK without a new decision record referencing the new hash.
invariants.test_hint: tamper test on a temp copy

invariants.statement: All cost metrics are labelled self-reported tokens; reports contain no joule, energy or carbon figures.
Fleet adapter process() never raises; every error returns {error_type ∈ harness taxonomy, message}.
Every fleet adapter output includes session_id and budget_consumed; routing outputs include the full probability distribution.
Viridis rail adapters make zero network calls unless their env configuration is present; tests use in-process fakes only.
When an IdentitySource is configured, route never returns an agent whose registry pubkey differs from or is missing in the configured source.
